decisions.reason: Submitting the project for developer verification to remediate a wallet warning does not change the landing-page hero wording.
The external project-verification submission does not change the hero layout, visual density, or control-clearance requirements.
The wallet false-positive remediation does not alter the deferred Transak provider, payment methods, conversion, or mint flow.
Developer verification of the web project does not change the Discord server configuration or community onboarding behavior.
The source requests an operational project-verification submission and does not revise any About-page copy.
The false-positive warning remediation does not change the policy blocking landing-page access from Mauritius.
Use of the existing Project Rebuild identity in a verification submission does not change the current or prospective product names.
The wallet-site warning submission does not change Lit Protocol ownership checks, gated decryption, or reader-access behavior.
The external false-flag remediation does not alter seedless wallet creation, custody, access, or reward-holding rules for fiat buyers.
The project-verification request does not revise the mission-page principles, product descriptions, or call to action.
Reporting and submitting a wallet-warning false positive does not entail a change to the FAQ, including its distinct claim that source code is verified on Basescan.
The developer-verification submission does not change landing-page mechanics, prize wording, emphasis, or tone.
